programme.title: Clambake
programme.desc: The king of rock 'n' roll, Elvis Presley, is as a lonely million-heir who gives up his fortune and trades identities with a water ski instructor to learn about life from the bottom up in this musical romp! Bill Bixby and Shelley Fabares also star.

programme.title: Fun in Acapulco
programme.desc: Elvis heads south of the border, where he’s fired as a boat hand, hired as a lifeguard and singer, admired by local beauties and inspired to jump off a 136-foot cliff. Put another way: he overcomes a fear of heights in spectacular fashion.

programme.title: Paradise, Hawaiian Style
programme.desc: Elvis takes to the skies over the island paradise of Kauai. He’s a partner in a helicopter charter service. Romance, naturally, is in the air for the King…but his business may be grounded.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: REVOLVER is populated with Guy Ritchie's (Snatch; Lock, Stock & Two Smoking Barrels) classic breed of fast-talking, sharp-suited gangsters but with a psychological twist that your mind may not be able to handle.

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: Parker is a thief who lives by a personal code of ethics: Don't steal from people who can't afford it and don't hurt people who don't deserve it. But on his latest heist, his crew double-crosses him, steals his stash, and leaves him for dead.

programme.title: Vivarium
programme.desc: A couple’s search for a dream home plunges them into a terrifying nightmare after they are trapped in a mysterious, labyrinth-like neighborhood of identical houses.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Owen, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz of KICK-ASS), a beautiful but peculiar girl who turns out to be a vampire.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: Purple Rain
programme.desc: Rock star Prince makes a spectacular feature film debut in this highly autobiographical blockbuster that won both an Oscar and a Grammy award.

programme.title: Do the Right Thing
programme.desc: Spike Lee wrote, produced, directed, and starred in this critically acclaimed comedy-drama, featuring Danny Aiello, chronicling the hottest day of the year in a diverse Brooklyn neighborhood.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: The Ming Dynasty Assassin
programme.desc: In the waning years of the Ming Dynasty, influential eunuch Wei Zhongxian extends his corrupt control over state affairs for selfish gain.

programme.title: Vengeance of an Assassin
programme.desc: An assassin escapes a battle and hides out in his childhood home. As he recovers, he realizes he has to fight faster and harder to survive.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: During the ninth century, a general's young daughter is kidnapped and trained to become an exceptional assassin. When she doesn't execute a mission, she is ordered to kill her betrothed, forcing her to choose between love, family and the assassins.

programme.title: Baby Assassins
programme.desc: Chisato and Mahilo are two high school girls who are about to graduate. They also happen to both be highly skilled assassins. When the organization they work for orders them to share a room, the relationship between them turns sour.

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville reprises his jackass role as 86-year-old Irving Zisman in the story of an old man saddled with the care of his grandson. The two hustle their way across America on an outrageous road trip pranking unsuspecting, real-life people.

programme.title: Coneheads
programme.desc: One look, and you know they're from a very strange place. They're from New Jersey, by way of France, by way of far-off, far-out Remulak. They're Coneheads.

programme.title: Like a Boss
programme.desc: Best friends, Mia and Mel (Tiffany Haddish & Rose Byrne), are running their own cosmetics company when a villainous beauty mogul (Salma Hayek) conspires to steal it. Mia and Mel must stick together and fight to reclaim their company.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: After six perfect weeks with boyfriend Mark Darcy, the mischievous Daniel Cleaver returns, claiming to be a reformed man. Can Bridget find a way to make true love last forever? A comedy that proves there's nothing like love to send you over the edge.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Bridget Jones is back, this time unexpectedly expecting a baby while unsure of the identity of the dad. Oscar® winners Renée Zellweger and Colin Firth are joined by Patrick Dempsey in this next chapter of Bridget's hysterically unpredictable life.

programme.title: Breakin' All the Rules
programme.desc: Inspired by his fiancée (who dumped him), a man publishes a break-up hand-book for men, becoming a best-selling author in the process.

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: Vincent is a cool, calculating contract killer at the top of his game. Max is a cabbie with big dreams and no results. On this fateful night, Max has to transport Vincent on his next job - one night, five stops, five hits and a getaway.

programme.title: Assassin Club
programme.desc: Henry Golding, Sam Neill, and Noomi Rapace star in this action-packed thriller. An elite assassin is given his final contract to kill six people around the world - only to discover the targets are equally skilled assassins hired to kill him.

programme.title: The Commuter
programme.desc: A businessman gets caught up in a criminal conspiracy during his daily commute home and works against the clock to stop a deadly attack to save the lives of his fellow passengers.

programme.title: Evelyn
programme.desc: Based on the true story of Desmond Doyle, who after losing his job and watching his wife leave with another man, has his children taken away by an arcane custody law. Doyle cleans up his act and wages an unlikely legal battle to regain custody.

programme.title: The Illusionist
programme.desc: In turn-of-the-century Vienna, a magician uses his abilities to secure the love of a woman far above his social standing.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
programme.desc: Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett star in the adaption of F. Scott Fitzgerald's story about an elderly man who ages backward and the problems that arise when he falls in love with a woman.

programme.title: Jericho
programme.desc: Amnesiac gunman Jericho is rescued and befriended by a charismatic and itinerant cowboy/preacher named Joshua. Together they survive certain danger, while Jericho searches to find the answer to his lost identity.

programme.title: Lawless

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014)

programme.title: The Godfather Part II

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The Bling Ring
programme.desc: A teenager and his gang of fame-obsessed youths use the Internet to track the whereabouts of celebrities, then rob their homes.

programme.title: Desperately Seeking Susan

programme.desc: In this sequel to BILL & TED'S EXCELLENT ADVENTURE, the dimwitted duo travel to Heaven, Hell and points in between as they meet (among others) Albert Einstein, the Easter Bunny and the Grim Reaper.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid

programme.title: Paradise, Hawaiian Style
programme.desc: Elvis takes to the skies over the island paradise of Kauai. He’s a partner in a helicopter charter service. Romance, naturally, is in the air for the King…but his business may be grounded.

programme.title: Blue Hawaii (1961)
programme.desc: His mother (Angela Lansbury) expects him to climb the corporate ladder. But Elvis would rather wear an aloha shirt than a white collar, so he goes to work as a tour guide. Lucky Elvis: his first customers are a car full of cuties.

programme.title: Thunder Alley (1967)
programme.desc: When a stock car driver suffering from blackouts hits the skids after a deadly crash, the only job he can find is racing in a demolition derby. But can he cure himself of his racing blackouts before they put a permanent end to his Indy 500 dreams?

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: REVOLVER is populated with Guy Ritchie's (Snatch; Lock, Stock & Two Smoking Barrels) classic breed of fast-talking, sharp-suited gangsters but with a psychological twist that your mind may not be able to handle.

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: Parker is a thief who lives by a personal code of ethics: Don't steal from people who can't afford it and don't hurt people who don't deserve it. But on his latest heist, his crew double-crosses him, steals his stash, and leaves him for dead.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: Stephen King's A Good Marriage
programme.desc: With a serial killer on the loose and a stranger stalking her family, a dedicated wife unveils a sinister secret about her husband that threatens their marriage, and their lives.

programme.title: Deliver Us from Evil (2014)
programme.desc: A NYPD officer (Eric Bana) and unconventional priest Mendoza (Edgar Ramírez) who join forces to investigate a series of disturbing & inexplicable crimes. Together, they must combat the possessions that are terrorizing their city before it's too late.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: Amistad
programme.desc: AMISTAD is about a 1839 mutiny onboard a slave ship that is traveling towards the Northeast Coast of America. Much of the story involves a court-room drama about the slave who led the revolt.

programme.title: Baby Assassins
programme.desc: Chisato and Mahilo are two high school girls who are about to graduate. They also happen to both be highly skilled assassins. When the organization they work for orders them to share a room, the relationship between them turns sour.

programme.title: Baby Assassins 2
programme.desc: After the agency suspends its top assassins, aspiring hitmen decide to eliminate them—leading to a lightning-fast showdown between trained killers.

programme.title: Night Of The Assassin
programme.desc: In the final days of the Joseon Dynasty, a renowned assassin faces an inescapable fate when he crosses paths with a former swordsman and village leader. Amidst the chaos, their encounter sets in motion an epic tale of irreversible destiny.

programme.title: Like a Boss
programme.desc: Best friends, Mia and Mel (Tiffany Haddish & Rose Byrne), are running their own cosmetics company when a villainous beauty mogul (Salma Hayek) conspires to steal it. Mia and Mel must stick together and fight to reclaim their company.

programme.title: Man of the Year
programme.desc: A comedian who hosts a news satire program decides to run for president, and a computerized voting machine malfunction gets him elected.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Superstars Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman and Julia Roberts star in award-winning director Steve Spielberg's updating of PETER PAN.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Bridget Jones is back, this time unexpectedly expecting a baby while unsure of the identity of the dad. Oscar® winners Renée Zellweger and Colin Firth are joined by Patrick Dempsey in this next chapter of Bridget's hysterically unpredictable life.

programme.title: Breakin' All the Rules
programme.desc: Inspired by his fiancée (who dumped him), a man publishes a break-up hand-book for men, becoming a best-selling author in the process.

programme.title: Sleepless in Seattle
programme.desc: Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan star in an enchanting romance about a widower whose son convinces him to find new love and the woman who answers his call.

programme.title: Assassin Club
programme.desc: Henry Golding, Sam Neill, and Noomi Rapace star in this action-packed thriller. An elite assassin is given his final contract to kill six people around the world - only to discover the targets are equally skilled assassins hired to kill him.

programme.title: The Commuter
programme.desc: A businessman gets caught up in a criminal conspiracy during his daily commute home and works against the clock to stop a deadly attack to save the lives of his fellow passengers.

programme.title: Vantage Point
programme.desc: During an historic counter-terrorism summit in Spain, the President of the United States is struck down by an assassin's bullet. Eight strangers have a perfect view of the kill, but what did they really see? Rated: PG-13

programme.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
programme.desc: Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett star in the adaption of F. Scott Fitzgerald's story about an elderly man who ages backward and the problems that arise when he falls in love with a woman.

programme.title: Marie Antoinette
programme.desc: Written and directed by Academy Award winner Sofia Coppola, Marie Antoinette is an electrifying yet intimate re-telling of the turbulent life of history's favorite villainess. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

programme.title: The Ballad of Lefty Brown
programme.desc: A merciless cowboy sets out on a dangerous journey across the frontier, determined to do whatever it takes to avenge his partner's brutal murder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero; we got a hedgehog. Superpowered with speed, Sonic races to save the world and stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from world domination. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz, and James Marsden star in the adventure that the whole family will enjoy.

programme.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
programme.desc: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic. Still, things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people in this hilarious and action-packed adventure.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The Bling Ring
programme.desc: A teenager and his gang of fame-obsessed youths use the Internet to track the whereabouts of celebrities, then rob their homes.

programme.title: The Real Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Before the movie, Jordan Belfort built a real life fraud empire... then the FBI started watching.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey
programme.desc: In this sequel to BILL & TED'S EXCELLENT ADVENTURE, the dimwitted duo travel to Heaven, Hell and points in between as they meet (among others) Albert Einstein, the Easter Bunny and the Grim Reaper.

programme.title: Eddie and the Cruisers
programme.desc: A reporter begins tracking down rumors of an unreleased album by a rock band whose charismatic leader disappeared after an accident and was presumed dead years before.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: An F.B.I. Agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfers who may be bank robbers.

programme.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey
programme.desc: Winnie-The-Pooh: Blood and Honey follows Pooh and Piglet as they go on a rampage after Christopher Robin abandons them.

programme.title: You're Next
programme.desc: The Davisons' family reunion goes awry when their home comes under siege by a mask-wearing team of crossbow-bearing assailants.

programme.title: Terrifier
programme.desc: Art The Clown sets his sights on three young women, along with anyone else that gets in his way.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: John Rambo is sent on assignment back to Southeast Asia to uncover evidence of still missing POWs, and ends up with his hands full when he comes up against Vietnamese soldiers still guarding the camps.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Rambo refuses to join his friend and former mentor, Colonel Trautman, on a mission to Afghanistan. The mission fails and Trautman is captured by Russian troops. Now Rambo must infiltrate the Russian fortress to save his only friend.

programme.title: Fool for Love
programme.desc: Sam Shepard's play, becomes a perfect screen adaptation. In a small motel room at the edge of the Mojave Desert, a loving couple argue, laugh and make love--sometimes all at once. An exploration of the human heart and the strange world of romance.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible II
programme.desc: The world's greatest spy, Ethan Hunt, returns and partners up with the beautiful Nyah Hall to stop renegade agent Sean Ambrose from releasing a new kind of terror on an unsuspecting world.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt hurdles into spectacular new adventures from Rome to Shanghai as he races to rescue a captured agent and stop Davian from eliminating his next target, Ethan’s wife.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Agent Ethan Hunt and his elite team go underground after a bombing implicates them as terrorists. While trying to clear their name, the team uncovers a plot to start a nuclear war.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Director James Mangold (FORD vs FERRARI) extends his crime thriller classic that brings together a powerhouse cast, including Robert De Niro, Sylvester Stallone, Ray Liotta, and Harvey Keitel.

programme.title: Nightcrawler
programme.desc: A freelance cameraman (Jake Gyllenhaal) goes to increasingly greater lengths to get shots of the most-lurid and disturbing crimes on the dark streets of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: A diamond heist gone haywire launches gangsters, bookies, and a dog on a rollicking ride through the rugged world of bare-knuckle boxing in search of the missing stone. Critically acclaimed comedy from Guy Ritchie.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: A new technologically-superior Soviet nuclear sub is heading for the U.S. coast; however, one CIA analyst thinks the captain will defect the submarine, and he only has hours to prove it.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America along with balancing the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and in New York during the 1910s and then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Grumpy Old Men
programme.desc: Jack Lemmon and Walter Matthau portray lifelong feuding neighbors making each day a hilarious game of revenge. But then voluptuous Ariel moves in nearby and their dormant hormones reignite in an all-out competition to win her favor.

programme.title: Grumpier Old Men
programme.desc: In this sequel to Grumpy Old Men, a vivacious Italian beauty attempts to convert Wabasha, Minnesota's cherished bait store into a romantic Italian restaurant.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

programme.title: King Kong (1976)
programme.desc: A petroleum exploration expedition comes to an isolated island and encounters a colossal giant gorilla.

programme.title: Thunderbolt and Lightfoot
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood and Jeff Bridges lead a strong supporting cast in this offbeat crime caper about a colorful group of bank robbers determined to break into the fortress-like Montana Armored Depository.

programme.title: Escape from Alcatraz
programme.desc: Superstar Clint Eastwood and director Don Siegel re-team for their fifth film in this fascinating account of the only three men ever to escape from the infamous maximum security prison at Alcatraz.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: After years of hiding from a society that shuns him, Hellboy and his team attempt to stop the resurrection of an ancient witch who once spread an unstoppable plague before she was locked away by the legendary King Arthur.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: A contemporary retelling of H.G.Wells' classic, the sci-fi thriller reveals the extraordinary battle for the future of humankind through the eyes of one American family.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: On a seemingly routine spacewalk, disaster strikes, leaving two astronauts completely alone. As the deafening silence tells them they have lost any link to Earth, the only way home may be to go further into the terrifying expanse of space.

programme.title: Just Like Heaven
programme.desc: He's convinced she's a spirit. She's convinced she's still alive. As they search for the truth of Elizabeth's past, their relationship changes from resentment to romance.

programme.title: The Sweetest Thing
programme.desc: A girl finds she is forced to educate herself on the etiquette of wooing the opposite sex when she finally meets Mr. Right.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: Come and Find Me
programme.desc: When a man's girlfriend goes missing, he tries to find her after he realizes she's not who she was pretending to be.

programme.title: Alice, Darling
programme.desc: Pushed to the breaking point, a woman enjoys some much-needed time away from her psychologically abusive boyfriend. However, when his vengeance is unleashed, it tests her strength, her courage, and the bonds of deep-rooted friendships.

programme.title: Black Bear
programme.desc: A filmmaker plays a calculated game of desire and jealousy in pursuit of a work of art that blurs the boundaries between autobiography and invention.

programme.title: Sabrina
programme.desc: Harrison Ford plays Linus Larrabee, a busy tycoon who has no room for love in his appointment book. When a romance between his playboy brother and Sabrina, daughter of the family chauffeur, threatens one of Linus’ business deals, he his schedule.

programme.title: Hollywood Homicide
programme.desc: A pair of detectives investigate a murder while pursuing their other full-time professions. Welcome to Hollywood Homicide - the only place where you can come to work hungry, horny, thirsty, and broke, and resolve all four by the end of the watch.

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: When a young Amish woman and her son get caught up in the murder of an undercover narcotic's agent, their saviour turns out to be hardened Philadelphia detective John Book.

programme.title: Jinn
programme.desc: Summer is a 17-year-old carefree black girl whose world is turned upside down when her mother, Jade, abruptly converts to Islam. Jade becomes a different person, prompting Summer to reevaluate her identity.

programme.title: Just Another Girl on the I.R.T
programme.desc: A hip, intelligent Brooklyn teenager dreams of escaping life in the projects to go to college and eventually become a doctor. Things go awry when she meets a cute dude with a Jeep, a brownstone, and a mom who spends a lot of time at her boyfriend's.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool (2018)
programme.desc: Tiffany Haddish is hysterical in Tyler Perry's most outrageous comedy yet. Wild child Tanya looks to her buttoned-up sister Danica to get back on her feet. As these opposites collide, Tanya learns that Danica's perfect life may not be what it seems.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight
programme.desc: Carter Oosterhouse travels to Central, LA; Buffalo, NY; Ft. Lauderdale, FL; & Stamford, CT to judge whose house has the most impressive Christmas display. The families up to win $50,000 are The Hohensee’s, Field’s, Messingschlager’s, and Pampena’s.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight
programme.desc: Taniya Nayak travels to Glen Allen, VA; Cranbury, NJ; Minnetrista, MN; & Toronto, Canada to judge whose house has the most impressive Christmas display. The families up to win $50,000 are The Thompson’s, Shaw’s, Kasper-Cook’s, and De Sario’s.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight
programme.desc: Carter Oosterhouse travels to Raleigh, NC; Corpus Christi, TX; North Ridgeville, OH; & Sinking Spring, PA to judge which family has the most impressive Christmas display. The families up to win $50,000 are Moore’s, Mazoch’s, Micklos’, and Simpson’s.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight
programme.desc: Taniya Nayak travels to Alexandria, LA; Maple Valley, WA; Boulder City, NV; & Manchester, TN to judge whose house has the most impressive Christmas display. The families up to win $50,000 are The Monkhouse’s, Pahl’s, Ryan-Musgrave’s, and Winton’s.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight
programme.desc: Featured displays include a wireless light show, an interactive gingerbread house, fun figurines and giant lollipops, and a large property with 78 wrapped trees..

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight
programme.desc: Featured displays include a seven-acre drive-through property, a blue-lighted design, a 40-foot wall of lights and suspended inflatables, and a concert of lights with a five-piece band.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: The non-human machine ruling elite of the nuclear war-torn future has dispatched a cyborg assassin into the past to kill a young boy because he soon will be the resistance leader against the machines.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future for all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

programme.title: After Earth
programme.desc: A crash landing leaves Kitai Raige (Jaden Smith) and his legendary father Cypher (Will Smith) stranded on Earth, 1,000 years after cataclysmic events forced humanity’s escape.

programme.title: Top Five
programme.desc: Written, directed and starring Chris Rock, TOP FIVE tells the story of New York City comedian-turned-film star Andre Allen, whose unexpected encounter with a journalist forces him to confront the comedy career—and the past—that he’s left behind.

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: Advertising executive Marcus Graham is a quintessential bachelor, Graham is never without a new lady on his arm. Enter Jacqueline, his new boss, and Marcus is on the receiving end of his own patented behavior for the first time!

programme.title: A Haunted House
programme.desc: When Malcolm takes the plunge and lets his girlfriend Keisha move into his house, he senses they're not alone. Videotaping a series of paranormal events, Malcolm is shocked to discover the love of his life is demonically possessed by an evil spirit.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
programme.desc: Optimus Prime and the Autobots take on their biggest challenge yet. When a new threat capable of destroying the entire planet emerges, they must team up with the powerful Transformers faction, the Maximals, to save Earth.

programme.title: Vantage Point
programme.desc: During an historic counter-terrorism summit in Spain, the President of the United States is struck down by an assassin's bullet. Eight strangers have a perfect view of the kill, but what did they really see? Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Aaron Eckhart and Jonathan Rhys Meyers star in the Vietnam War epic. When a small outpost is ambushed, a US Army squad must take the battle below ground on a high-stakes mission in a new type of warfare the likes of which they have never seen.

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

programme.title: MST3K: The Loves Of Hercules
programme.desc: The Far-fetched flight scenes and tangled plot lines of this breathy 1960 Jayne Mansfield saga nudge Jonah and friends one step closer to the edge.

programme.title: MST3K: Lords Of The Deep
programme.desc: In part three of a Gauntlet six-movie binge, Jonah and the bots take on the 1989 film Lords of the Deep.

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The Incredibly Strange Creature

programme.title: Thunder Alley (1967)
programme.desc: When a stock car driver suffering from blackouts hits the skids after a deadly crash, the only job he can find is racing in a demolition derby. But can he cure himself of his racing blackouts before they put a permanent end to his Indy 500 dreams?

programme.title: Pajama Party
programme.desc: When a Martian scout named Go-Go is sent to explore Earth for a possible conquest, he lands in the middle of a wild, teenage pajama party, giving Mars second thoughts about invasion...and turning the party into an out-of-this-world cosmic shindig!

programme.title: How to Stuff a Wild Bikini
programme.desc: While stationed in Tahiti, Frankie (Frankie Avalon) learns he’s in danger of losing Dee Dee (Annette Funicello) to another guy! That is, until a wacky witch doctor (Buster Keaton) conjures up a gorgeous bikini-clad vixen...whom no man can resist!

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Deliver Us from Evil (2014)
programme.desc: A NYPD officer (Eric Bana) and unconventional priest Mendoza (Edgar Ramírez) who join forces to investigate a series of disturbing & inexplicable crimes. Together, they must combat the possessions that are terrorizing their city before it's too late.

programme.title: The Witch
programme.desc: In 1630 New England, panic and despair envelops a farmer, his wife and their children when youngest son Samuel suddenly vanishes.

programme.title: Vivarium
programme.desc: A couple’s search for a dream home plunges them into a terrifying nightmare after they are trapped in a mysterious, labyrinth-like neighborhood of identical houses.

programme.title: Amistad
programme.desc: AMISTAD is about a 1839 mutiny onboard a slave ship that is traveling towards the Northeast Coast of America. Much of the story involves a court-room drama about the slave who led the revolt.

programme.title: Hotel Rwanda
programme.desc: The film chronicles the true story of Paul Rusesabinga (Don Cheadle), a brave hotel manager who risked his life and those of his family to take in more than 1,000 refugees during the 1994 genocide of the Tutsus by Hutu militia.

programme.title: Losing Isaiah
programme.desc: Jessica Lange plays an adoptive mother who gives an abandoned child a new chance at life. Halle Berry is the birth mother who cleans up her life and sets out to reclaim the child.

programme.title: Baby Assassins 2
programme.desc: After the agency suspends its top assassins, aspiring hitmen decide to eliminate them—leading to a lightning-fast showdown between trained killers.

programme.title: Night Of The Assassin
programme.desc: In the final days of the Joseon Dynasty, a renowned assassin faces an inescapable fate when he crosses paths with a former swordsman and village leader. Amidst the chaos, their encounter sets in motion an epic tale of irreversible destiny.

programme.title: Reign Of Assassins
programme.desc: Elusive assassin Drizzle transforms herself into modest shop owner Zeng Jing (Michelle Yeoh) in order to transport the remains of an exalted Buddhist monk to their eternal resting place, but finds her mission unexpectedly complicated.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Superstars Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman and Julia Roberts star in award-winning director Steve Spielberg's updating of PETER PAN.

programme.title: RV (2006)
programme.desc: A forced family vacation in a recreational vehicle rapidly turns into a disaster.

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: Sleepless in Seattle
programme.desc: Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan star in an enchanting romance about a widower whose son convinces him to find new love and the woman who answers his call.

programme.title: My Best Friend's Wedding
programme.desc: Commitment-shy Jules Potter reluctantly realizes she is in love with her best friend Michael. There is just one catch: he's about to marry someone else. Jules will do anything to steal him back... except tell him the simple truth.

programme.title: Bewitched (2005)
programme.desc: A has-been actor tries to convince the perfect woman to play Samantha in an adaptation of the classic TV series; a woman who, unbeknownst to him, really is a witch!

programme.title: Vantage Point
programme.desc: During an historic counter-terrorism summit in Spain, the President of the United States is struck down by an assassin's bullet. Eight strangers have a perfect view of the kill, but what did they really see? Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Source Code
programme.desc: Jake Gyllenhaal stars in this action thriller about a man who awakens in another man’s body to discover only he has the ability to stop a terrorist attack on a commuter train.

programme.title: Wild Things
programme.desc: Kevin Bacon, Matt Dillon and Neve Campbell star in a steamy story of murder, intrigue and sex. Rated: R

programme.title: Marie Antoinette
programme.desc: Written and directed by Academy Award winner Sofia Coppola, Marie Antoinette is an electrifying yet intimate re-telling of the turbulent life of history's favorite villainess. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: The People vs. Larry Flynt
programme.desc: Two-time Oscar winner Milos Forman directs Woody Harrelson and Courtney Love in this acclaimed film about "Hustler" publisher Larry Flynt. Rating: R

programme.title: The Ballad of Lefty Brown
programme.desc: A merciless cowboy sets out on a dangerous journey across the frontier, determined to do whatever it takes to avenge his partner's brutal murder.

programme.title: Forsaken (2014)
programme.desc: In 1872, an embittered gunslinger named John Henry Clayton attempts to make amends with his estranged father, Reverend Samuel Clayton, while their community is besieged by ruthless land-grabbers.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
programme.desc: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic. Still, things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people in this hilarious and action-packed adventure.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014)
programme.desc: When NY City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: The Real Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Before the movie, Jordan Belfort built a real life fraud empire... then the FBI started watching.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: An F.B.I. Agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfers who may be bank robbers.

programme.title: King of New York
programme.desc: Recently freed from prison, Frank White (Christopher Walken) begins to exterminate the drug lords who rose to power in his absence. When a group of enraged cops declares war on him, Frank's answer is to put a contract out on the cops.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Sean Penn's breakthrough dramatic performance.

programme.title: Terrifier
programme.desc: Art The Clown sets his sights on three young women, along with anyone else that gets in his way.

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County where he begins to target a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween.

programme.title: Terrifier 3
programme.desc: Art the Clown is set to unleash chaos on the unsuspecting residents of Miles County as they peacefully drift off to sleep on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Fool for Love
programme.desc: Sam Shepard's play, becomes a perfect screen adaptation. In a small motel room at the edge of the Mojave Desert, a loving couple argue, laugh and make love--sometimes all at once. An exploration of the human heart and the strange world of romance.

programme.title: Christine (1983)
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Stephen King, CHRISTINE tells the story of a 1957 Plymouth that takes on human characteristics.

programme.title: Paris, Texas
programme.desc: Travis Henderson, an aimless drifter who has been missing for four years, wanders out of the desert and must reconnect with society, himself, his life, and his family.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Agent Ethan Hunt and his elite team go underground after a bombing implicates them as terrorists. While trying to clear their name, the team uncovers a plot to start a nuclear war.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programme.desc: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating the Syndicate - an International rogue organization as highly skilled as they are, committed to destroying the IMF.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt, a secret agent, is framed for the deaths of his espionage team and attempts to flee government assassins after him. He races against the clock in order to discover the truth.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: A diamond heist gone haywire launches gangsters, bookies, and a dog on a rollicking ride through the rugged world of bare-knuckle boxing in search of the missing stone. Critically acclaimed comedy from Guy Ritchie.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Director James Mangold (FORD vs FERRARI) extends his crime thriller classic that brings together a powerhouse cast, including Robert De Niro, Sylvester Stallone, Ray Liotta, and Harvey Keitel.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America along with balancing the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America along with balancing the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and in New York during the 1910s and then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Ace Ventura Pet Detective is on the case to find the Miami Dolphins' missing mascot and quarterback Dan Marino. He goes eye to eye with sharks, stakes out the Miami Dolphins and woos and wows the ladies. He always gets his man...or beast.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Africa's the place where Ace is on the case, setting out to rescue an animal he loathes - a bat! If you're ready to laugh like a pack of hyenas, if you want more fun than an industrial-sized barrel of monkeys, you'll know what to do. Heed the call.

programme.title: Thunderbolt and Lightfoot
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood and Jeff Bridges lead a strong supporting cast in this offbeat crime caper about a colorful group of bank robbers determined to break into the fortress-like Montana Armored Depository.

programme.title: Escape from Alcatraz
programme.desc: Superstar Clint Eastwood and director Don Siegel re-team for their fifth film in this fascinating account of the only three men ever to escape from the infamous maximum security prison at Alcatraz.

programme.title: Dillinger
programme.desc: An account of the notorious gangster, John Dillinger, from midway through his bank-robbing career up until his final shootout outside the Biograph Theatre.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: On a seemingly routine spacewalk, disaster strikes, leaving two astronauts completely alone. As the deafening silence tells them they have lost any link to Earth, the only way home may be to go further into the terrifying expanse of space.

programme.title: Gemini Man
programme.desc: Will Smith stars in the nonstop action thrill-ride from Academy Award®-winning director Ang Lee. Retired hitman (Smith) is forced on the run and finds himself hunted by his ultimate adversary - a younger clone of himself.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: A contemporary retelling of H.G.Wells' classic, the sci-fi thriller reveals the extraordinary battle for the future of humankind through the eyes of one American family.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: Adaptation
programme.desc: Director Spike Jonze delivers a stunningly original comedy that seamlessly blends fictional characters and situations with the lives of real people. As Charlie struggles to adapt Orlean's best-selling book "The Orchid Thief".Rated: R

programme.title: Across the Universe
programme.desc: A love story about a British boy and an American girl set against the backdrop of the social upheaval of the 1960s.

programme.title: Black Bear
programme.desc: A filmmaker plays a calculated game of desire and jealousy in pursuit of a work of art that blurs the boundaries between autobiography and invention.

programme.title: Miller's Girl
programme.desc: A creative writing assignment yields complex results between a teacher and his talented student.

programme.title: A Simple Favor
programme.desc: Stephanie is a widowed single mother who works as a vlogger in Connecticut. When her best friend mysteriously disappears one day, Stephanie launches her own investigation by digging into the woman's past, finding a few surprises along the way.

programme.title: Hollywood Homicide
programme.desc: A pair of detectives investigate a murder while pursuing their other full-time professions. Welcome to Hollywood Homicide - the only place where you can come to work hungry, horny, thirsty, and broke, and resolve all four by the end of the watch.

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: When a young Amish woman and her son get caught up in the murder of an undercover narcotic's agent, their saviour turns out to be hardened Philadelphia detective John Book.

programme.title: Patriot Games

programme.title: Naruto: ¿Los Anbu se rinden? Los recuerdos de Naruto
programme.desc: Los cazadores especiales Anbu utilizan la hipnosis regresiva sobre Naruto para obtener información sobre las acciones de Genno, pero no tienen éxito. La aldea escondida entre las cascadas llevará a cabo sus maniobras cerca de la frontera de la aldea.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan y Kel están en el trabajo cuando un payaso de circo entra en Rigby’s y roba la tienda. Las cosas empeoran cuando el mismo payaso aparece más tarde en la fiesta de cumpleaños de Kyra, y los muchachos deciden entrar en acción.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kel gana 64 millones de dólares en la lotería y quiere dividir el premio con su mejor amigo, Kenan. Parece que las cosas están saliendo bastante bien para ambos, hasta que Kel pierde el billete ganador.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Rigby's ha sido elegida como el set de la nueva película "Policía de Supermercado 3", y Kenan y Kel se ofrecen como extras. Todo lo que tienen que hacer es seguir las instrucciones del director, pero terminan arruinando todo.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Después de que Kel le causara serias heridas en la espalda a Roger, este le prohibió la entrada a la casa de los Rockmore. Como resultado de ello, Kel trata de convencer a Roger que le permita volver a entrar.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Roger obtiene un nuevo trabajo que requiere mudarse a Pummis, Montana, teniendo que llevarse a toda la familia con él. Kel prepara un regalo de despedida para Kenan, pero cuando llega a la casa de los Rockmore, no hay nadie.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Con Yugi al final de sus cuerdas y el maniático Marik librando una guerra total, ¿puede el amigo más viejo de Marik llegar a Marik a tiempo para ayudarlo a recuperar sus sentidos antes de que su locura lo abrume?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Las tres cartas de Dios egipcio son robadas! ¡Un nuevo villano aterrador emerge! ¡Monstruos reales comienzan a aparecer en todo el mundo! ¿Podrán Yugi y la pandilla descubrir cómo se conectan estos extraños eventos antes de que el planeta sea destruido?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Con El Sello de Orichalcos, Gurimo no solo puede tener diez monstruos a la vez, sino que cada criatura recibe un impulso de poder de las energías malévolas de Orichalcos!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡No solo nuestro mundo está al borde del apocalipsis, sino que todo un dominio de monstruos también está al borde del colapso! ¡La Tierra y el dominio de los monstruos deben unirse y luchar contra el terror más grande que jamás hayan enfrentado!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y la pandilla emprendieron una caminata a través del país cuando se les pidió ayuda de un antiguo enemigo tuerto.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡El demonio de Alister no solo gana puntos de ataque por cada monstruo ardiente en el campo, sino que también puede tomar el control de los monstruos de Kaiba! ¿Alister se vengará o Kaiba recibirá ayuda del dominio de los monstruos?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¿Cuántos años han pasado desde que se transmitió el último episodio de Cybernet? Desde entonces han habido muchos cambios en los videojuegos. Acompáñanos a través de un recuento de lo más importante que ocurrió durante nuestra ausencia.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Si eres fan de los videojuegos, probablemente también te gusten los juegos con gráficas retro en pixeles. Hacemos un recuento de los juegos modernos que lucen como clásicos, así como un Top 10 de nuestros soundtracks en chiptunes favoritos.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¿Te gustan los videojuegos de terror? En éste capítulo de Cybernet conoceremos el origen de una de las franquicias más famosas de survival horror de la industria: Resident Evil. También tenemos un Top 10 con los mejores juegos de terror de la historia.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¿Cuánto dinero estarían dispuestos a pagar por su juego favorito? En el capítulo de hoy les contaremos cuáles han sido los juegos que más caro se han vendido en la historia.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: La situación se complica gravemente en Sabaody. Si ya de por sí era peligrosa la aparición de Bartholomew Kuma, ahora entra en escena el almirante Kizaru, uno de los integrantes más poderosos de toda la Marina.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Parece que la Marina lo tiene todo a su favor con la llegada de Kizaru. De hecho, los afamados novatos con grandes recompensas están teniendo serios problemas para seguir en pie luchando contra él.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Tras un largo e intenso combate contra Kuma, los Sombrero de Paja consiguen derrotarlo uniendo sus fuerzas.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: La situación parece empeorar por momentos. Tras la llegada de Kizaru, los Sombrero de Paja están empezando a caer uno detrás de otro y no parece que tengan alguna posibilidad de salir con vida de allí.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Durante la pelea contra Bartholomew Kuma, el Shichibukai está haciendo uso de su habilidad para hacer desaparecer a todos y cada uno de los integrantes de los Sombrero de Paja, lo que hace que Luffy se suma en la desesperación por no poder ayudarlos.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Regresamos al periodo feudal de Grand Jipang en este episodio especial de la serie. Esta vez va a tener lugar un acontecimiento muy importante: la Gran Carrera de Altares Móviles.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Después de los sucios trucos de la Compañía Thriller, ya no quedan altares móviles para participar en la gran carrera. Aunque gracias a la ayuda de algunos antiguos participantes, Luffy y compañía podrán participar en la competencia.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Parece que Kuma ha mandado por los aires a todos los integrantes de los Sombrero de Paja por algún motivo que se desconoce. Debido a ello, Luffy aterriza desorientado en una isla donde parece que solo hay mujeres.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Grand Zi-O contra Oma Zi-O: una feroz batalla en la que el poder de todos los Heisei Riders se utiliza en todo su potencial. Una distorsión del tiempo trae los eventos de regreso a 2019. En ese año, todo había cambiado.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: En este mundo restaurado en 2019, Kakogawa Hiryuu es el nuevo soberano. Geiz ataca a Zi-O para salvar el mundo, ya que no quiere pelear contra Geiz.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Tsukuyomi fue capturado por Swartz. Swartz le cuenta el secreto de su familia, por qué perdió la memoria y cómo se unió a Geiz y los demás.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Un corredor de maratón, compañero de Sougo, desaparece en medio de la carrera, como si lo hubieran llevado. En medio de esto, aparece un Kamen Rider dentro de un Time Mazine.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Se revela la identidad de otro Drive: un Roidmude que imitaba a Ora. Sougo y Geiz no saben si creer la conversación de Time Jackers. Heure está confundido por todo esto. Geiz comienza a cuestionarse si era correcto que él permaneciera en esa época.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Geiz está atrapado en Otro Mundo, y Woz Branco resurge, desarrollando una estrategia para traer de vuelta a Geiz. Otros Mundos, mundos de posibilidades inexistentes, se crean con la intención de convocar a "Jinetes Oscuros".

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Algo extraño está comenzando a suceder en el mundo. Una pared emerge del suelo, dividiendo a Japón. Sougo vuelve a la relojería y se da cuenta de que algunos Relojes Ride pierden sus poderes, y algunos relojes muestran anormalidades en el tiempo.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Kadoya Tsukasa, Kamen Rider Decade, declara que destruirá el mundo. Los mundos de cada Kamen Rider comenzaron a fusionarse. Skywall, el muro del mundo Kamen Rider Build, emerge de la superficie.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Kamen Rider Tsukuyomi aparece debido a una acción de Sougo en 2068, antes de enfrentarse a Oma Zi-O. Tsukuyomi, sin embargo, sorprende y termina traicionando a todos, haciendo que el apocalipsis ya plantado por Swartz vaya aún más lejos.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: GTA V, el juego que cambio el paradigma de diseno de Rock Star Games. Tambien, resulto siendo uno de los titulos mas exitosos para la franquicia y uno de los videojuegos mas vendidos en la historia

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.title: El Fantástico Jaspion

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Misa logra encontrar la identidad de Kira dentro del Grupo Yotsuba: Higuchi, L desarrolla un plan para llevar a Higuchi a las instalaciones de Sakura TV, donde está transmitiendo un especial de Kira que presentará a un testigo con una identidad oculta.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Higuchi del Grupo Yotsuba, trata de asesinar a Matsuda del cuerpo especial y se sorprende cuando este no muere, para averiguar su verdadero nombre Higuchi hace un trato con Rem para obtener “los ojos”.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Higuchi es capturado y cuenta a los investigadores todo sobre el Death Note, L deduce que debe haber más de dos libretas y declara que el caso sigue abierto, Light que esta sentado a su lado toca la libreta...

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light ha recobrado sus recuerdos, entonces ordena a Misa que retome los asesinatos como Kira, El Shinigami Rem se da cuenta que todo va de acuerdo al plan de Light y que L arrestará a Misa como Kira a menos de que Rem actúe rápidamente.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light ha removido a todos los estorbos de su camino, y está cerca de alcanzar su mundo perfecto, por solicitud del equipo de investigación secretamente se convierte en el nuevo L. El mundo se dirige a una era obscura bajo el dominio de Kira.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Aparece un nuevo investigador, Near, una figura central en el SPK, una organización dedicada a atrapar a Kira sin depender de L, Near esta consciente de la existencia de los Death Notes y busca obtener uno.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light actuando como L, revela a Near que su hermana Sayu ha sido secuestrada por alguien que desea intercambiarla por un Death Note, Near descubre que el cambio se llevará a cabo en Los Angeles y promete ayudar.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light trata de descubrir donde se esconden Mello y la mafia, para esto, usa los ojos de Misa y así descubrir al actual dueño del Death Note, al escribir el nombre del dueño en el Death Note furtivamente lo manipula y descubre el paradero del grupo.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Mello irrumpe en el cuartel de SPK para recuperar una foto suya y asegurarse de no ser asesinado por Kira, a cambio de que Near le regrese la foto, Mello le cuenta una pista importante sobre los Death Notes: algunas de las reglas son falsas.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: ¡Tsubasa regresa al campo con estilo! El partido contra el Munich se torna interesante. Con Tsubasa nuevamente en acción, sus compañeros de equipo juegan como atletas completamente diferentes. Hyuga y Tsubasa deciden hacer las cosas aún más interesantes.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: El equipo aterriza en Francia y se prepara para los partidos. El entrenador ordena un día de descanso, pero Tsubasa no puede relajarse. Mientras pasea por París, ve a alguien que le resulta conocido y tiene habilidades asombrosas.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: El portero de Italia, Gino Hernández, hace paradas increíbles. Su récord perfecto le ha dado la reputación de ser el mejor portero de Europa. Su habilidad pone a Japón a la ofensiva, pero Misaki está observando. El entrenador hace un cambio sorprendente.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Gracias a Tsubasa y Misaki, Japón empata con Italia, dejando a los europeos reforzando sus defensas con la esperanza de nivelarse. Mientras tanto, cuando sólo falta un minuto para el final, la multitud clama por el equipo de Japón. Tsubasa se arriesga...

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Francia, el país anfitrión, tiene su primer partido contra Inglaterra. Elle Sid Pierre, el capitán francés, sorprende con su elegante juego. Mientras tanto, aun cuando Tsubasa y sus amigos están impresionados, el equipo de Francia siente la presión.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Roberto Hongo, habla con Katagiri en las afueras de París y no quiere que Tsubasa se entere que está a sólo kilómetros de distancia. Como ex entrenador de Tsubasa, Roberto todavía se siente culpable de haber roto la promesa que le hizo.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Alabama Shakes - Austin City Limits

programme.title: AIR play Moon Safari - Royal Albert Hall

programme.title: Koko Pop

programme.title: Other Voices

programme.title: Memory Lane

programme.title: La Gran Aventura
programme.desc: Un joven que está acampando en el bosque ayuda a rescatar al Presidente de los Estados Unidos cuando el Air Force One es derribado cerca de donde está su camping.

programme.title: The Code

programme.title: IP Man – El Maestro Del Kung Fu
programme.desc: El legendario maestro de artes marciales Ip Man trabaja como capitán de la policía local y es acusado del asesinato de un gángster local. En busca de venganza, la hija del criminal comienza a perseguir a Ip Man.

programme.title: Love & Other Drugs
programme.desc: Maggie y Jamie comienzan una relación que los enfrenta a una enfermedad y a la droga del amor.

programme.title: Un Zoológico Extraordinario
programme.desc: Tae Soo, un abogado temporal, revitaliza un zoológico en quiebra sin animales. Él y su equipo se disfrazan de animales, lo que genera complicaciones éticas y profesionales. Secret Zoo es una comedia sobre la creatividad ante la adversidad.

programme.title: ¡Arréstame Si Puedes!
programme.desc: Edgar y Morales, dos estafadores, se encuentran con un fugitivo buscado por asesinato. Deciden advertirle que hay policías cerca del lugar y pronto se arrepienten, ya que les roba el auto y los mantiene como rehenes junto con una camarera.

programme.title: Shark Lake
programme.desc: Meredith es una joven madre y agente de la localidad de Lake Tahoe. Cuando diversos ataques de tiburones desatan el pánico en la ciudad, la joven y un experto en escualos deciden investigar los extraños incidentes.

programme.title: 407 El vuelo de las tinieblas
programme.desc: Hace diez años, el joven Neuw sobrevivió milagrosamente a un desastre aéreo. Ella insistió en que el desastre fue causado por un espíritu vengativo, pero su creencia fue devaluada por quienes la rodeaban.

programme.title: Prisioneros del diablo
programme.desc: En noviembre de 2012 Rachel Kusza y su equipo de cineastas viajaron a Transilvania para documentar el bosque de Baciu Un bosque con una oscura historia de sucesos extraños, apariciones de fantasmas y innumerables casos de personas desaparecidas.

programme.title: No Dispare
programme.desc: A los 9 años, David perdió a sus padres y a su hermana en una masacre en una tienda y ahora tiene que vivir con sus abuelos. Su abuelo tiene la tarea casi imposible de dar a David una nueva perspectiva de la vida, del futuro.

programme.title: El Orfanato

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Un amigo llamado Harry va a visitar la habitación de Mr. Bean. Desafortunadamente para Bean, Harry tiene cosas diferentes y también es un tipo glotón que come demasiado, tanto que toda la comida en el refrigerador de Bean se ha ido.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Luego de que su vieja tv explote, Mr Bean va a comprar la televisión más grande del mundo solo para descubrir que tiene un precio que igualar.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
